<Mountain> and the <Statue> - Walking Tour
Tour-Category: walking

Stop 1: <Mountain>

Coordinates: 10.813277, 107.894085

Type/Specialty: Mountain and cultural site

<Mountain> rises 649 meters above the plain. A cable car and a forest trail lead up to the summit. Two pagodas stand near the top.

Directions: Walk on to <Statue>.

Stop 2: <Statue>

Coordinates: 10.813277, 107.894085

Type/Specialty: Reclining Buddha statue

You see the reclining Buddha statue here is 49 meters long and 7 meters high. This statue is also the longest reclining Buddha in <Region>. It is the largest reclining Buddha statue in <Country>. The statue lies on a terrace near the summit.

That's 2 stops in all.

If you would like to eat nearby we can build you a restaurant tour.
